title: Implement persistent registry, checkpoints, and task validation
acceptance_criteria: Task state persists across fresh sessions
notes: Completed in continuation session (2026-10-26). Framework-first per ADR-0007: canonical KU JSONL store (state/knowledge-units/, committed) + derived rebuildable SQLite index (state/registries/, git-ignored); all writes flow through kureg-load (schema validation, cross-record checks, conflict detection, atomic transaction with deferred FKs). Stable IDs minted from source identity + content locators (mint_ku_id; locator-less records rejected). Schema v1.1 per ADR-0008: overlap_type stored separately from disposition; Superseded requires non-empty superseded_rationale (cross-checks shared by validate-registry --kus and kureg-load). Acceptance criteria evidence: (1) schema documented+validated: v1.1 + validate_ku_file with cross-checks, exercised by tests; (2) task state persists across fresh sessions: committed JSONL task queue re-validated this session + registry rebuild reproducibility (two independent rebuilds byte-identical, tested + demoed); (3) recovery tested: corrupt DB, missing DB, failed-load rollback, idempotent reload, ID conflicts. NON-CLAIMS: canonical store holds 0 records - no knowledge units extracted, classified or dispositioned; no semantic verification; BOOT-004 omission pilot not started. Commit hash recorded in the follow-up state commit.
